33352.a:
```sh
zcat access.log.2.gz | head          # o'qish, fayl joyida qoladi
gunzip access.log.2.gz               # access.log.2 yaratiladi, .gz o'chadi
gunzip -k access.log.2.gz            # -k: .gz ham qoladi
gzip -dc access.log.2.gz             # = zcat (-d ochish, -c stdout)
```
- `zcat` = `gunzip -c`.
- Log tahlilida `zcat` afzal: diskka ochilgan nusxa yozilmaydi (to'lgan diskda muhim), arxiv buzilmaydi.
- macOS'da `zcat` `.Z` kutishi mumkin — `gzcat` yoki `gzip -dc`.

33353.a:
```sh
ls /var/log/nginx/
# access.log  access.log.1  access.log.2.gz  access.log.3.gz

zgrep " 500 " /var/log/nginx/access.log*        # oddiy va .gz fayllar
zcat -f /var/log/nginx/access.log* | grep -c " 500 "

# eskidan yangiga tartibda
ls -tr /var/log/nginx/access.log* | xargs zcat -f | awk '{print $9}' | sort | uniq -c
```
`zgrep` `grep` flaglarini qabul qiladi: `zgrep -i`, `-c`, `-E`, `-h` (fayl nomisiz).
Gotcha: `zcat app.log` (siqilmagan) — "not in gzip format" xatosi; `-f` qo'ying yoki `zgrep` ishlating.

33354.a:
| Siqish | cat | grep | less |
|---|---|---|---|
| gzip (.gz) | `zcat` | `zgrep` | `zless` |
| bzip2 (.bz2) | `bzcat` | `bzgrep` | `bzless` |
| xz (.xz) | `xzcat` | `xzgrep` | `xzless` |
| zstd (.zst) | `zstdcat` | `zstdgrep` | `zstdless` |

```sh
zless /var/log/syslog.3.gz          # / bilan qidirish, q chiqish
zdiff config.v1.gz config.v2.gz
xzcat backup.sql.xz | head -50
```
`less` ko'p tizimlarda `lesspipe` orqali `.gz`ni o'zi ham ocha oladi.

33355.a:
```sh
# DB tiklash
zcat dump.sql.gz | psql -h db -U app appdb
gunzip -c dump.sql.gz | mysql appdb

# backup — oraliq fayl yo'q
pg_dump appdb | gzip -6 > appdb-$(date +%F).sql.gz
pg_dump appdb | zstd -T0 > appdb.sql.zst          # tezroq, ko'p yadro

# tarmoq orqali
ssh db1 'pg_dump appdb | gzip' > appdb.sql.gz
zcat appdb.sql.gz | ssh db2 psql appdb

# yaxlitlikni tekshirish
gzip -t dump.sql.gz && echo OK
```
Gotcha: pipe'da xato yashirinadi — `set -o pipefail`, aks holda `pg_dump` yiqilsa ham bo'sh/yarim `.gz` "muvaffaqiyatli" yaratiladi.

33356.a:
```sh
time zcat big.log.gz | grep -c ERROR
time pigz -dc big.log.gz | LC_ALL=C grep -c ERROR       # odatda tezroq

# ko'p fayl parallel
ls access.log.*.gz | xargs -P 8 -I{} sh -c 'zcat {} | grep -c " 500 "' | paste -sd+ | bc

# zgrep -F: regex emas, oddiy matn — tezroq
zgrep -F "order_id=42" app.log.*.gz
```
logrotate'da `compresscmd /usr/bin/zstd` + `compressext .zst` — keyin `zstdcat`/`zstdgrep`.
Muntazam qidiruv kerak bo'lsa — grep emas, markaziy log tizimi (Loki/ELK).

33357.a:
```
stdin --> [tee file.log] --> stdout (ekran yoki keyingi pipe)
                  |
                  v
               file.log
```
```sh
./deploy.sh | tee deploy.log              # ekranda ham, faylda ham
./deploy.sh 2>&1 | tee -a deploy.log      # stderr ham, append
ping -c 3 8.8.8.8 | tee ping.txt | grep time=
make build | tee build.log | grep -i error
```
Bir nechta fayl: `cmd | tee a.log b.log`.

33358.a:
```sh
sudo echo "nameserver 1.1.1.1" > /etc/resolv.conf
# bash: /etc/resolv.conf: Permission denied

echo "nameserver 1.1.1.1" | sudo tee /etc/resolv.conf          # ustidan yozish
echo "vm.swappiness=10"   | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.conf       # qo'shish
echo "deb ... main"       | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/x.list > /dev/null   # ekranga chiqarmaslik

# muqobil
sudo sh -c 'echo "x" >> /etc/file'
```
`> /dev/null` — `tee`ning stdout'ini yashirish (secret bo'lsa ayniqsa).
Gotcha: `-a`ni unutish = faylning butun mazmuni o'chadi.

33359.a:
```vim
:w !sudo tee % > /dev/null
```
- `:w !cmd` — buferni faylga emas, buyruq stdin'iga yozadi.
- `%` — joriy fayl yo'li.
- Vim "fayl tashqarida o'zgardi" deydi — `L` bosing.

Yaxshiroq odat: tizim fayllarini `sudoedit /etc/nginx/nginx.conf` (yoki `sudo -e`) bilan oching — muharrir oddiy user sifatida ishlaydi, faqat saqlash root bilan; `sudo vim` muharrirning o'zini (plaginlar bilan) root qiladi.

33360.a:
```sh
false | tee out.log; echo $?           # 0  — xato yashirindi!

set -o pipefail
false | tee out.log; echo $?           # 1

make test | tee test.log
echo "make: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}, tee: ${PIPESTATUS[1]}"
```
CI'da (GitHub Actions `bash` shell default `-eo pipefail`, lekin oddiy `sh` emas) — skript boshida:
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
```
Busiz `go test ./... | tee report.txt` testlar yiqilsa ham pipeline yashil bo'ladi.

33361.a:
```sh
# bitta o'qish: checksum + siqilgan nusxa + qatorlar soni
cat big.log | tee >(sha256sum > big.sha256) >(gzip > big.log.gz) | wc -l

# backup'ni ham lokal, ham masofaga
pg_dump appdb | gzip | tee appdb.sql.gz | ssh backup 'cat > /backups/appdb.sql.gz'

# xatolarni alohida faylga ajratish, hammasini umumiy log'ga
./job.sh 2> >(tee -a errors.log >&2) | tee -a all.log
```
Gotcha: `>(...)` fon jarayonlari asosiy buyruqdan **keyin** tugashi mumkin — natija faylini darhol o'qisangiz to'liq bo'lmasligi mumkin. Bash'ga xos (POSIX `sh`da yo'q).

33362.a:
```sh
python app.py | tee app.log             # chiqish to'planib keladi
python -u app.py | tee app.log          # darhol
stdbuf -oL -eL ./tool | tee tool.log    # libc stdio ishlatadigan dasturlar uchun
grep --line-buffered ERROR big.log | tee errors.log
```
- libc qoidasi: stdout TTY bo'lsa line-buffered, pipe/fayl bo'lsa full-buffered; stderr — unbuffered.
- `stdbuf` faqat libc stdio'ga ta'sir qiladi; Go, Java o'z bufferlarini boshqaradi (Go `os.Stdout` bufferlanmaydi).
- Konteynerlarda ham shu: `docker logs`da loglar kechiksa — `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1`.
